reason.FLIGHT_UNKNOWN: We could not find this flight. Check the flight number and date, or ask staff.
reason.OUTBOUND_MISSING: Tell us the flight you are connecting to. It is on your boarding pass.
reason.FLIGHT_CANCELLED: This flight is cancelled. Ask staff about rebooking before you move.
reason.AMBIGUOUS_FLIGHT: More than one flight matches. Choose the correct flight from the list.
reason.AMBIGUOUS_LANDMARK: More than one place matches that name. Choose the place you are at.
reason.AMBIGUOUS_DATE: This flight number runs on more than one date. Confirm your travel date.
reason.AMBIGUOUS_PICKUP: We need one clear pickup point. Choose where staff should meet you.
reason.GATE_STALE: The gate information is out of date. Check the departures board or ask staff.
reason.GATE_CONFLICT: Two sources show different gates. Confirm your gate with staff before you move.
reason.GATE_UNKNOWN: No gate has been published yet. Check the departures board again soon.
reason.GATE_CHANGED: Your gate has changed. Follow the new route shown on this screen.
reason.CUTOFF_MISSING: The boarding cutoff time has not been published. Check with your airline.
reason.CUTOFF_STALE: The boarding cutoff time is out of date. Check with your airline or staff.
reason.CUTOFF_CONFLICT: Sources give different boarding cutoff times. Confirm the time with your airline.
reason.CUTOFF_ESTIMATED: This boarding cutoff is an estimate and may change. Plan to arrive earlier.
reason.CUTOFF_PASSED: Boarding has closed for this flight. Ask your airline about the next option.
reason.TIGHT_MARGIN: Your connection is tight. Start moving now and follow the route.
reason.NEGATIVE_MARGIN: The transfer takes longer than the time left before boarding closes. Ask staff for help now.
reason.LOWER_BOUND_EXCEEDS_CUTOFF: Even the fastest route may not arrive before boarding closes. Ask staff for help now.
reason.QUEUE_BOUND_STALE: The queue time is out of date, so this estimate may change. Ask staff for the current wait.
reason.QUEUE_BOUND_MISSING: No queue time is available for this checkpoint. Allow extra time and ask staff.
reason.QUEUE_BOUND_CONFLICT: Queue time reports disagree. Allow extra time and ask staff.
reason.READINESS_UNKNOWN: We do not know when you can start moving. Tell staff when you are ready.
reason.STAFF_HANDOFF_PENDING: Staff have not confirmed the handoff yet. Wait at your pickup point.
reason.LOCATION_UNKNOWN: We do not know where you are. Choose a landmark near you.
reason.LOCATION_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm where you are before we show directions.
reason.MAP_UNAVAILABLE: The map is not available right now. Ask staff for directions.
reason.FACILITY_CLOSED: This facility is closed. Choose another one or ask staff.
reason.FACILITY_STALE: Facility status is out of date. Confirm it with staff before you go.
reason.LIFT_CLOSED: This lift is closed. Ask staff for a step-free route.
reason.LIFT_UNVERIFIED: We cannot confirm that this lift is working. Ask staff before you use it.
reason.EDGE_RESTRICTED: This passage is not open to passengers. Follow the approved route shown.
reason.CHECKPOINT_INELIGIBLE: You cannot use this checkpoint for your journey. Use the checkpoint on the route.
reason.ACCESS_UNVERIFIED: We cannot confirm access on this route. Ask staff to check it.
reason.NO_PATH: We found no route to this gate. Ask staff for directions.
reason.NO_ACCESSIBLE_PATH: No step-free route is available. Ask staff for help.
reason.ROUTE_REVOKED: This route has been replaced. Follow the updated route on this screen.
reason.ROUTE_EXPIRED: This route has expired. Scan the code again for the current route.
reason.ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: No route is available right now. Ask staff for directions.
reason.WRONG_AIRPORT: This route is for a different airport. Check that you chose the right airport.
reason.PICKUP_UNCONFIRMED: Your pickup point is not confirmed yet. Confirm it before staff are sent.
reason.PICKUP_INELIGIBLE: Staff cannot reach you at this point. Choose a nearby point they can reach.
reason.CONSENT_MISSING: Please confirm the request before it is sent to staff.
reason.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Staff must approve this request before assistance is sent.
reason.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: Staff did not respond in time. Ask a staff member at the nearest help point.
reason.APPROVAL_DECLINED: Staff could not approve this request. Use the staffed help point shown below.
reason.CASE_CANCELLED: This request was cancelled. Ask staff if you still need help.
reason.CASE_NOT_PENDING: This request is no longer waiting for approval. Check its current status.
reason.CASE_SCOPE_CHANGED: Your gate or pickup point changed after you made the request. Confirm the details again.
reason.DISPATCH_UNCONFIRMED: Assistance has not been confirmed as sent yet. Staff are checking.
reason.DISPATCH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: We cannot confirm whether assistance was sent. Staff are checking. Go to the help point if you need help now.
reason.WRONG_ROLE: You do not have permission for this action. Ask staff for help.
reason.STALE_REVISION: This screen is out of date. Refresh it to see the latest information.
reason.DUPLICATE_EVENT: This request was already received. No action is needed.
reason.ALREADY_DECIDED: Staff already recorded a decision for this request. Check its status.
reason.SESSION_EXPIRED: This session has ended. Start again to continue.
reason.URGENT_SAFETY: You need urgent medical or safety help. Go to the nearest staffed help point now.
reason.AIRCRAFT_UNMATCHED: We could not match an aircraft position to your flight. Your flight details still apply.
reason.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: The aircraft position is not available right now. The gate and times still apply.
reason.POSITION_STALE: The aircraft position is old. Use the time shown to judge how current it is.
reason.ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE: No estimate is available for this step. Ask staff for the current wait.
reason.ESTIMATE_STALE: This estimate is out of date. Ask staff for a current time.
reason.NOT_APPLICABLE: This check does not apply to your journey.
reason.AMENITY_CLOSED: This place is closed right now. Choose another place or ask staff.
reason.DATA_STALE: Some information is out of date. Check with staff before you move.
reason.UNSUPPORTED_INPUT: We could not understand that request. Try fewer words or use the buttons.
reason.INVALID_ARGUMENTS: We could not use that information. Check the entry and try again.
reason.UNAUTHORIZED_TOOL: This action is not available here. Ask staff for help.
reason.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests were sent. Wait a moment, then try again.
reason.TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again, or ask staff if it still does not load.
reason.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A source of information is unavailable. Check with staff before you move.
reason.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: We could not finish the check in time. Ask staff for the latest information.
